This World in which we live, is a crazy place; rising gas prices, wars and rumors of wars, civil disputes, perversion, and blatant-sin create a tapestry of chaos that ebbs and flows with the tide of humanity's whims. This house of cards that the powers-that-be have built falls the moment it's faced with the Kingdom of God. Our hope, our faith, is in an unwavering Kingdom; a government system who does not bend to the whims and desires of man. No matter the calamity that would try and befall us, we stand firm with the Word of God, our King, as our foundation and strong tower. Be encouraged by this message from our Senior Pastor, Earl Glisson, that we are established upon a Mountain that cannot be moved.

latestSermons.rawDescription:
Many desire to be used of God but too often question His direction and the things that happen because of His leading. Pastor Earl, utilizing some moments in the lives of Adam, Abraham, Moses, and Jesus, shows us what it looks like to actually do what our Heavenly Father says. Sometimes God doesn't give us a grand plan with tons of details. More times than not it is a simple statement and leading like with Abraham, "go to the land I will show you." It's what we do in these types of situations that can propel us forward in our relationship with God or hinder His plans for us.

Many have spent their lives mocking Jesus, spitting in the face of who He is and why He came to the Earth. Our lives folded into the crowds who demanded He be crucified. But each and every one of us has a choice to make when we see Jesus hanging on the cross, in scripture. Instead of following the masses, we could be like one of the thieves hanging with him. We can either maintain that we are a victim of our environment, or we can recognize the compassion of Jesus. It only takes one look from our King, one statement, one act, and everything can change.

latestSermons.youtubeDescription:
Faith is defined in Hebrews 11:1 as the "substance of things hoped for, and the evidence of things not seen." Faith is an incredibly misunderstood subject in the Church today, and yet it's meant to be an aspect of Christianity that we should all be operating in every day. Why is this so misunderstood? How come people seem to misinterpret God's intent for our use of faith? Over the course of this series we'll be showing the scriptural basis for the answers to these questions and seeing what God put in His Word for the way He wants His followers to operate in faith.

latestSermons.rawDescription:
Fame and fortune. Power to influence lives. Ability to make a difference in the world. These things serve as motivators for achievement and many dream of soaring to the top by taking the lead on the path to the pinnacle of success. The world calls those who reach such heights “leaders in their field.” But what if a person had accomplished all of this while ignoring God’s calling for them to do something entirely different with their life? By the world’s standards, “leaders in their field” would be considered great examples of success, but that does not necessarily equate to greatness in God’s Kingdom – where it really matters. This is why the body of Christ, or the “church” as we are called, needs to derive its definition of a great leader from the only infallible source – the written Word of God. In the pages of this book you will discover how a true leader is a Lead Follower, which is what we are all called to be.

Purchase your copy here!

latestSermons.rawDescription:
The life of Joseph in the Old Testament is one of adventure, purpose, and great reward, but these come at a great price of being ridiculed, falsely accused, and overcoming a lot of adversity. Joseph had to be a man of integrity, destiny, and perseverance to build the legacy he left. Today, many Christians aren’t coming close to accomplishing what Joseph did because they get stuck at two of the most unanswered questions today, “why are we here?” and “what’s next after salvation?”

In Cows, Crows, & Constellations, Pastor Earl Glisson will guide you through the journey and adventures of Joseph, exploring the reasons why he was so successful and how his life and his principles are so necessary for our lives, today. So get ready to find your purpose and destiny, get ready to achieve a dreamer’s reward!

Purchase the book here:
https://anchorfaith.store/product/cowsandcrows/

This World in which we live, is a crazy place; rising gas prices, wars and rumors of wars, civil disputes, perversion, and blatant-sin create a tapestry of chaos that ebbs and flows with the tide of humanity's whims. This house of cards that the powers-that-be have built falls the moment it's faced with the Kingdom of God. Our hope, our faith, is in an unwavering Kingdom; a government system who does not bend to the whims and desires of man. No matter the calamity that would try and befall us, we stand firm with the Word of God, our King, as our foundation and strong tower. Be encouraged by this message from our Senior Pastor, Earl Glisson, that we are established upon a Mountain that cannot be moved.

As believer's in Christ we don't have to live a mundane life of mediocrity. Jesus bestowed blessing, authority, and the ability to rise above every situation with king-quality status. In this message, delivered from Rhema and Kenneth Hagin's Campmeeting on Wednesday night July 28th, is a powerful look into the life a believer should be living. We are kings and queens, we are priests, that have the anointing of our Heavenly Father on our life, so let's live like it.

Rhema Bible Church in Broken Arrow, Oklahoma is the headquarters for the globally renowned and influential Rhema Bible Training College. With 28,000+ alumni worldwide, 90,000+ trained students, schools in 54 nations, and countless more churches planted, Rhema's global impact and influence continues to grow! Anchor Faith Church is continuously honored to be a part of those tens-of-thousands-of-graduates and countless-church-plants that make an impact with the same spirit-of-faith that Rhema has come to be known for! Take a moment and read more about all they continue doing to influence the World with the message of faith, and give to their endeavors financially! They truly are GREAT GROUND to sow into.

sermons.title: Do What He Says
sermons.description: Many desire to be used of God but too often question His direction and the things that happen because of His leading. Pastor Earl, utilizing some moments in the lives of Adam, Abraham, Moses, and Jesus, shows us what it looks like to actually do what our Heavenly Father says. Sometimes God doesn't give us a grand plan with tons of details. More times than...
sermons.rawDescription:
Many desire to be used of God but too often question His direction and the things that happen because of His leading. Pastor Earl, utilizing some moments in the lives of Adam, Abraham, Moses, and Jesus, shows us what it looks like to actually do what our Heavenly Father says. Sometimes God doesn't give us a grand plan with tons of details. More times than not it is a simple statement and leading like with Abraham, "go to the land I will show you." It's what we do in these types of situations that can propel us forward in our relationship with God or hinder His plans for us.

No matter the onslaught, they stood firm in their faith, if they wavered, they quickly got back on the right path! This message, we look to Paul's example and the words that Jesus spoke through him and the apostle John. Many have spent their lives mocking Jesus, spitting in the face of who He is and why He came to the Earth. Our lives folded into the crowds who demanded He be crucified. But each and every one of us has a choice to make when we see Jesus hanging on the cross, in scripture. Instead of following the masses, we could be like one of the thieves hanging with him. Faith is defined in Hebrews 11:1 as the "substance of things hoped for, and the evidence of things not seen." sermons.rawDescription:
Pastor Earl continues from our previous message, "Love's Proof," looking at how Jesus expects us to be loving each other in the church. He launches out from 1 Timothy where Paul paraphrases a large portion of Jesus's ministry and what He did to Timothy, and where exactly we see Jesus do these things in the Gospels. Our example of love is not an earthly one, but the incorruptible form of love that Jesus showed while physically on the earth. Discover exactly how God loves you.

sermons.rawDescription:
Fame and fortune. Power to influence lives. Ability to make a difference in the world. These things serve as motivators for achievement and many dream of soaring to the top by taking the lead on the path to the pinnacle of success. The world calls those who reach such heights “leaders in their field.” But what if a person had accomplished all of this while ignoring God’s calling for them to do something entirely different with their life? By the world’s standards, “leaders in their field” would be considered great examples of success, but that does not necessarily equate to greatness in God’s Kingdom – where it really matters. This is why the body of Christ, or the “church” as we are called, needs to derive its definition of a great leader from the only infallible source – the written Word of God. In the pages of this book you will discover how a true leader is a Lead Follower, which is what we are all called to be.

Purchase your copy here!
https://anchorfaith.store/product/leadfollower/

sermons.rawDescription:
The life of Joseph in the Old Testament is one of adventure, purpose, and great reward, but these come at a great price of being ridiculed, falsely accused, and overcoming a lot of adversity. Joseph had to be a man of integrity, destiny, and perseverance to build the legacy he left. Today, many Christians aren’t coming close to accomplishing what Joseph did because they get stuck at two of the most unanswered questions today, “why are we here?” and “what’s next after salvation?”

In Cows, Crows, & Constellations, Pastor Earl Glisson will guide you through the journey and adventures of Joseph, exploring the reasons why he was so successful and how his life and his principles are so necessary for our lives, today. So get ready to find your purpose and destiny, get ready to achieve a dreamer’s reward!

You are the light that breaks the darkness

sermons.rawDescription:
(Verse 1)
You are the light that breaks the darkness
The hope of all creation
Your reign none will deny

(Verse 2)
Your mighty voice, it can’t be silenced
the calm among the violence
Your love has conquered fear
(Chorus 1)

You cannot be moved
You cannot be shaken
Life is found in You
Your word is true

Verse 3)
Your grace is strong when there is weakness
Your peace is overwhelming
So We are not alone

(Verse 4)
You’re ever present ever faithful
Our strength and our defender
In you we overcome

(Bridge)
We will rise for your kingdom
It cannot be overcome
We will rise for your kingdom
You are mighty, we are one
We will rise
We will rise

(Chorus 2)
We cannot be moved
We cannot be shaken
We are found in You
Your word is true

audioEpisodes.rawDescription:
Then a mighty, rushing wind shattered rocks, and uprooted the mountains. But the lord was not in the wind. Then a deafening earthquake felled forests and split the land in two but the Lord was not in the earthquake. Then a fire roared, consuming everything it touched in a blaze of brilliant light but the lord was not in the fire. But after the wind, the earthquake, and the fire, there was a voice. And it was still and it was small and it was mighty and it was truth. And it was the voice that made this world in six days, that sang rays of light into being with four words. One breath of perfected power established gravity just to show all of time that none can defy it, or like lightning they’d fall in thunderous clamor. And it was the voice of a friend, full of confidence and love, that called you by your name in your weakness, and redeemed you in your strength. And It’s the voice of the one who set the captives free, who put a comma at the end of your sentence, where your story should have ended and said “there’s more!” It calls forth greatness from this tomb of empty echoes. And from lifeless lips it gathers praise. It's the sound of moved mountains! It's the sound the earth makes when the righteous prevail! And it's the voice after the fire! It's the voice of a the King, robed in glorious majesty. And it sounds like you.

Then a deafening earthquake felled forests and split the land in two but the Lord was not in the earthquake. Then a fire roared, consuming everything it touched in a blaze of brilliant light but the lord was not in the fire. But after the wind, the earthquake, and the fire, there was a voice. One breath of perfected power established gravity just to show all of time that none can defy it, or like lightning they’d fall in thunderous clamor. And it was the voice of a friend, full of confidence and love, that called you by your name in your weakness, and redeemed you in your strength. And It’s the voice of the one who set the captives free, who put a comma at the end of your sentence, where your story should have ended and said “there’s more!” It calls forth greatness from this tomb of empty echoes. And from lifeless lips it gathers praise. It's the sound of moved mountains! It's the sound the earth makes when the righteous prevail! And it's the voice after the fire! It's the voice of a the King, robed in glorious majesty. And it sounds like you.

Then a mighty, rushing wind shattered rocks, and uprooted the mountains. But the lord was not in the wind. Then a deafening earthquake felled forests and split the land in two but the Lord was not in the earthquake. Then a fire roared, consuming everything it touched in a blaze of brilliant light but the lord was not in the fire. But after the wind, the earthquake, and the fire, there was a voice. And it was still and it was small and it was mighty and it was truth. And it was the voice that made this world in six days, that sang rays of light into being with four words. One breath of perfected power established gravity just to show all of time that none can defy it, or like lightning they’d fall in thunderous clamor. And it was the voice of a friend, full of confidence and love, that called you by your name in your weakness, and redeemed you in your strength. And It’s the voice of the one who set the captives free, who put a comma at the end of your sentence, where your story should have ended and said “there’s more!” It calls forth greatness from this tomb of empty echoes. And from lifeless lips it gathers praise. It's the sound of moved mountains! It's the sound the earth makes when the righteous prevail! And it's the voice after the fire! It's the voice of a the King, robed in glorious majesty. And it sounds like you.

audioEpisodes.rawDescription:
The world has a lot of causes they rally behind, and they love to apply pressure for The Church to support said causes. These causes can range from social and racial injustices, keeping or obtaining new rights and freedoms, or helping "save our planet." The big issue, many churches will decide to just rally under those causes without ever seeking out what God has to say about them. The Church has a cause, and that cause is what Jesus was sent to do. So jump into this message as Pastor Earl takes time to show us what the cause of Christ is, and how we can rise up and be a voice for that cause in the earth today.

This World in which we live, is a crazy place; rising gas prices, wars and rumors of wars, civil disputes, perversion, and blatant-sin create a tapestry of chaos that ebbs and flows with the tide of humanity's whims. This house of cards that the powers-that-be have built falls the moment it's faced with the Kingdom of God. Our hope, our faith, is in an unwavering Kingdom; a government system who does not bend to the whims and desires of man. No matter the calamity that would try and befall us, we stand firm with the Word of God, our King, as our foundation and strong tower. Be encouraged by this message from our Senior Pastor, Earl Glisson, that we are established upon a Mountain that cannot be moved.

audioEpisodes.title: Do What He Says
audioEpisodes.description: Many desire to be used of God but too often question His direction and the things that happen because of His leading. Pastor Earl, utilizing some moments in the lives of Adam, Abraham, Moses, and Jesus, shows us what it looks like to actually do what our Heavenly Father says. Sometimes God doesn't give us a grand plan with tons of details. More times than...
audioEpisodes.rawDescription:
Many desire to be used of God but too often question His direction and the things that happen because of His leading. Pastor Earl, utilizing some moments in the lives of Adam, Abraham, Moses, and Jesus, shows us what it looks like to actually do what our Heavenly Father says. Sometimes God doesn't give us a grand plan with tons of details. More times than not it is a simple statement and leading like with Abraham, "go to the land I will show you." It's what we do in these types of situations that can propel us forward in our relationship with God or hinder His plans for us.

But each and every one of us has a choice to make when we see Jesus hanging on the cross, in scripture. Instead of following the masses, we could be like one of the thieves hanging with him. audioEpisodes.rawDescription:
Faith is defined in Hebrews 11:1 as the "substance of things hoped for, and the evidence of things not seen." Faith is an incredibly misunderstood subject in the Church today, and yet it's meant to be an aspect of Christianity that we should all be operating in every day. Why is this so misunderstood? How come people seem to misinterpret God's intent for our use of faith? Over the course of this series we'll be showing the scriptural basis for the answers to these questions and seeing what God put in His Word for the way He wants His followers to operate in faith.

audioEpisodes.rawDescription: The World places a massive amount of value on the education system, and from a fallen-state, it seems to be rightly placed. The idea that through education we can become better human-beings, more knowledgeable of failures, more creative in finding new solutions to help others prosper; this all seems well and good. The problem with this mentality, is the realization that some of the most highly educated people on our planet are some of the most vial-wicked-individuals. This paradox allows the Kingdom of God to step in and show how our education must be framed: through God's Word. God tells us in Joshua 1:8 that when we study His Word, we will make our way prosperous. Pastor Earl dives into this subject of true Kingdom education, and how we can benefit from God's education system now, no matter how many degrees we may have. Jump in, and be encouraged about God's education system.

audioEpisodes.title: Lead Follower - Uncommon Leadership
audioEpisodes.description:
Fame and fortune. Power to influence lives. Ability to make a difference in the world.

audioEpisodes.rawDescription:
Fame and fortune. Power to influence lives. Ability to make a difference in the world.


These things serve as motivators for achievement and many dream of soaring to the top by taking the lead on the path to the pinnacle of success. The world calls those who reach such heights “leaders in their field.” But what if a person had accomplished all of this while ignoring God’s calling for them to do something entirely different with their life?


By the world’s standards, “leaders in their field” would be considered great examples of success, but that does not necessarily equate to greatness in God’s Kingdom – where it really matters. This is why the body of Christ, or the “church” as we are called, needs to derive its definition of a great leader from the only infallible source – the written Word of God. In this sermon you will discover how a true leader is a Lead Follower, which is what we are all called to be.

audioEpisodes.description:
You don’t have to wait your entire life to do something great, you have the opportunity to do something great, now.
Most people miss their destinies because they are too busy looking for it. These people feel that what they are currently doing now can’t possibly be “it” or can’t get them to “it.” Unfortunately, they wander through life always looking for...
audioEpisodes.rawDescription:
You don’t have to wait your entire life to do something great, you have the opportunity to do something great, now.


Most people miss their destinies because they are too busy looking for it. These people feel that what they are currently doing now can’t possibly be “it” or can’t get them to “it.” Unfortunately, they wander through life always looking for their “next” and actually end up unprepared because they lack the rare quality of faithfulness to the ordinary.


In this book, we discuss the mundane, ordinary, routine, details of our everyday lives that most seem to look past. It’s these uninteresting and routine things that God wants to use to test and perfect us for our destiny. When you look through the Bible, you will find men and women doing everyday, ordinary tasks for God. These ordinary tasks however, were the agent by which God brought the extraordinary. Learn to see that God can do more than you imagine, right where you are. This sermon is for your now, because your now, your ordinary, has never been more needed.

audioEpisodes.description: You remember old vinyl records and cassette tapes? audioEpisodes.rawDescription: You remember old vinyl records and cassette tapes? When recording-artists and bands would release LP's and full-length albums, the record labels would often compose the track listing in such a way that the popular songs that were more marketable would end up on the A-Side. The rest of the tracks were then pushed to the B-Side of the album or tape. Most people LOVE the A-Side tracks; the poppy tunes, the ones you hear on radio stations in heavy rotation. If you only listen to these A-Side songs, you won't get the full and clear picture of an artist or band's sound, and the message they may want to communicate on that album. Sometimes the most musically-technical songs, the deep cuts, find themselves pushed to the B-Side because they may not appeal to the masses. The Church today has encountered this problem; by finding themselves only wanting to hear the popular side of God's Word. If we are to be true believers and followers of Christ, we have to desire balance, and balance comes from looking into and discover the "full counsel of God's Word." Pastor Earl begins a series where we're going to look at what the B-Side of some popular preaching subjects are, and how we can stay balanced with this B-Side teaching. Knowing what these deep-cuts-of-God says, can give us a renewed appreciation and honor for the things we find in the A-Side subjects.
